verdict.rationale: Bolna's GitHub repo describes itself as an end-to-end open-source, production-ready framework for voice conversational apps, and its docs cover self-hosting Bolna on your own servers with Docker or Kubernetes. Together these deliver the core of the story. missing for 10: confirmation that the enterprise on-premise deployment is the same open-source runtime rather than a separate gated build, detailed deployment and scaling documentation beyond a one-line summary, independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Bolna is the end-to-end open source production ready framework for quickly building LLM based voice driven conversational applications.
Learn how to self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments.
